items.name: Greatsword
items.desc: A plain heavy blade. HP 0 / Atk 1 / Def 5, atk speed x0.9. No special effect.

items.name: Sleeve Sword
items.effectNote: Circle Slash's charge is instantly at max the moment it's held; release any time for the max-charge effect.
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.5 / Def 0, atk speed x1.2. Circle Slash's charge is instantly at max the moment it's held (release any time for the max-charge effect; Dash Slash still combos mid-hold). If not Swordsman: atk speed x1.2 (so 1.2x1.2).

items.name: Normal Armor
items.desc: HP 10 / Atk 0 / Def 10. No special effect.

items.name: Swordsman Armor
items.effectNote: Circle Slash charging speed scales with attack speed{mul}.

effectNoteWith.text: With Sleeve Sword also equipped, Circle Slash damage is boosted by attack speed instead of charge rate{mul}.

items.desc: HP 5 / Atk 0.5 / Def 5, atk speed x1.1. Circle Slash charging speed = original x attack speed; if Sleeve Sword is also equipped, Circle Slash damage is boosted by attack speed instead. If not Swordsman: atk speed x1.5 (so 1.1x1.5).

items.name: Normal Shoes
items.desc: HP 5 / Atk 0 / Def 5, move x1.5. No special effect.

items.name: Swordsman Shoes
items.desc: HP 3 / Atk 0.3 / Def 3, atk speed x1.1, move x2. Doubles Dash Slash distance. If not Swordsman: x1.1 movement.

items.name: Normal Ring
items.desc: HP 1 / Atk 0.1 / Def 1. Life regen +1.

items.name: Bleeding Ring
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.2 / Def 1. +0.1% lifesteal; lifesteal now also applies to Bleeding damage.

items.name: Normal Necklace
items.desc: HP 1 / Atk 0.1 / Def 1. EXP +20%; tower upgrade cost -20%.

items.name: Builder's Necklace
items.desc: HP 1 / Atk 0 / Def 2. All towers +0.1 flat attack (boostable by upgrades / VS count multiplier).

items.name: Normal Bracelet
items.desc: HP 1 / Atk 0.1 / Def 1. Character and tower area +10%.

items.name: Sniper Bracelet
items.desc: HP 2 / Atk 0.1 / Def 0. Character and tower range +10%.

items.name: Plague Flask
items.effectNote: Basic attacks apply Poison on every hit ({pct:poisonRatio} of the hit over {n:poisonSeconds}s).
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.4 / Def 0, atk speed x1.1. Basic attacks apply Poison (120% over 3 s) on every hit. If not Plaguebringer: atk speed x1.15.

items.name: Miasma Robe
items.effectNote: Poison Barrel's cloud drifts toward you at {n:cloudDriftSpeed} tile/s, and Poison Boost also refreshes every Poison's duration.
items.desc: HP 6 / Atk 0 / Def 4. Poison Barrel's cloud drifts toward the character (1 tile/s) and Poison Boost also refreshes all poison durations. If not Plaguebringer: HP x1.1.

items.name: Carrier's Boots
items.effectNote: Dashing leaves a poison trail for {n:trailSeconds}s: every {n:trailTickSeconds}s, each enemy in it is poisoned as if by a hit worth {n:trailDamageMul}x your basic attack.
items.desc: HP 3 / Atk 0 / Def 3, move x1.4. Dashing leaves a poison trail (0.5x basic dmg/s for 3 s). If not Plaguebringer: move x1.15.

items.name: Ring of Contagion
items.effectNote: Spreading Plague also jumps to the {n:extraTargets} next-nearest enemies, not just the nearest one.
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.2 / Def 0. Spreading Plague jumps to the 3 nearest enemies instead of 1. If not Plaguebringer: +1 life regen.

items.name: Pestilent Locket
items.effectNote: Poison Boost multiplies ALL DoTs (Poison, Toxic, Bleeding, Burning) by x{n:dotBoostMul}, not just Poison; its cooldown is +{n:extraCooldownSeconds}s.
items.desc: HP 2 / Atk 0 / Def 2. Poison Boost doubles ALL DoTs (Poison, Toxic, Bleeding, Burning), cooldown +2 s. If not Plaguebringer: EXP +15%.

items.name: Blightweaver Band
items.effectNote: Poisoned enemies also tick {pct:contactShare} of their poison onto enemies touching them (within {n:contactRadius} tile).
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.1 / Def 1. Poisoned enemies also tick 50% of their poison onto enemies touching them. If not Plaguebringer: area +10%.

items.name: Hourglass Scepter
items.effectNote: Activates Time Flow's dormant clause: every DoT you deal ticks x{n:dotSpeedMul} as fast (same total, shorter duration).
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.5 / Def 0. Activates Time Flow's dormant clause: all DoT damage from the character ticks 100% faster (same total, half duration). If not Time Lord: atk +0.3.

items.name: Chronomail
items.effectNote: Time Flow spreads incoming damage over x{n:windowMul} its window; at or below {pct:lowHpFraction} HP, over x{n:lowHpWindowMul}.
items.desc: HP 8 / Atk 0 / Def 6. Time Flow converts incoming damage over 8 s instead of 4 s; at <=30% HP, over 12 s. If not Time Lord: def +5.

items.name: Sandals of the Second Hand
items.effectNote: Time's rewind moves enemies to where they were {n:rewindSeconds}s ago.
items.desc: HP 3 / Atk 0 / Def 2, move x1.3. Time's rewind moves enemies to their position of 6 s ago instead of 3 s. If not Time Lord: move x1.1.

items.name: Loop Ring
items.effectNote: Time holds +{n:extraCharges} charge and recharges x{n:rechargeSpeedMul} as fast.
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.2 / Def 1. Time has 4 charges and recharges 25% faster. If not Time Lord: +1 life regen.

items.name: Pendulum Pendant
items.effectNote: Executing a "future" enemy refunds {n:executeRefundCharges} Time charge; elites/bosses lose {pct:eliteExecuteFraction} of their HP instead.
items.desc: HP 2 / Atk 0 / Def 2. Executing a "future" enemy refunds 1 Time charge; elites/bosses lose 60% instead of 50%. If not Time Lord: EXP +15%.

items.name: Bracer of Overlap
items.effectNote: Time Lock holds +{n:extraZones} zone at once; casting past the cap teleports and detonates every standing zone.
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.1 / Def 1. Time Lock can hold 2 zones at once; casting a third teleports and detonates BOTH. If not Time Lord: area +10%.

items.name: Ring of a Thousand Cuts
items.effectNote: Thousand Cuts applies {n:bleedStacks} Bleeding per attack.
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.2 / Def 1. Thousand Cuts applies 2 Bleeding per attack. If not Swordsman: +1 life regen.

items.name: Duelist's Pendant
items.effectNote: A Dash Slash cast during a charged Circle Slash refunds {pct:chargeRefund} of the charge, so you can chain a second slash.
items.desc: HP 3 / Atk 0.2 / Def 0. A Dash Slash cast during a charged Circle Slash refunds 50% of the charge (chain a second slash). If not Swordsman: EXP +15%.

items.name: Bracer of the Whirlwind
items.effectNote: Circle Slash radius x{n:radiusMul} and knockback x{n:knockbackMul}.
items.desc: HP 0 / Atk 0.1 / Def 2. Circle Slash radius +25% and knockback +50%. If not Swordsman: area +10%.
